scope: Kinematic demand from original-anchor 25 N and 50 N/m extensor response. Mesh and channel are prescribed by interpolating the installed end-cap transforms. Edge ratios and overlap measure that deformation map, not actual TPU strain or contact. Lumen estimate assumes uniform incompressible round tube stretch and ignores flattening, bending and wire motion. Tube stiffness is an axial linear estimate with assumed moduli; series budget is not hardware.
